run_multinode_training: run multinode SLIP pre-training with submitit on a SLURM cluster using configurable GPUs and nodes
parse_submitit_args: parse command-line arguments for SLIP submitit training including gpus, nodes, timeout, partition, and comment
create_trainer_job: create a Trainer instance that wraps SLIP main with GPU args setup and checkpoint support for submitit
setup_slurm_executor: setup a submitit AutoExecutor with SLURM parameters for multinode GPU training jobs
get_shared_folder: get a shared checkpoint folder path for the current user on a SLURM cluster
